title: Could you help me calculate the average single career span value in years f
question: Could you help me calculate the average single career span value in years for all baseball players? Please precise the result as a float number. First, calculate the difference in years, months, and days between the debut and final game dates. For each player, the career span is computed as the sum of the absolute number of years, plus the absolute number of months divided by 12, plus the absolute number of days divided by 365. Round each part to two decimal places before summing. Finally, average the career spans and round the result to a float number.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    player_id,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', final_game) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', debut) AS INTEGER) AS raw_y,
    CAST(strftime('%m', final_game) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%m', debut) AS INTEGER) AS raw_m,
    CAST(strftime('%d', final_game) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%d', debut) AS INTEGER) AS raw_d
  FROM player
  WHERE debut IS NOT NULL AND final_game IS NOT NULL
    AND debut != '' AND final_game != ''
),
parts AS (
  SELECT
    player_id,
    ROUND(ABS(raw_y), 2) AS y,
    ROUND(ABS(raw_m) / 12.0, 2) AS m,
    ROUND(ABS(raw_d) / 365.0, 2) AS d
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(y + m + d), 2) AS avg_career_span
FROM parts

The first draft used a total day difference which does not match the requested component-wise logic. The second draft was closer but had incorrect division logic in the parts CTE (dividing by 30 instead of 12 for months, and not dividing days by 365 in the parts CTE correctly relative to the final sum). The new SQL strictly follows the question's formula: ABS(year_diff) + ABS(month_diff)/12 + ABS(day_diff)/365, with each part rounded to 2 decimal places before summing.

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    ABS(julianday(final_game) - julianday(debut)) AS diff_days
  FROM player
  WHERE debut IS NOT NULL AND final_game IS NOT NULL
),
parts AS (
  SELECT
    ROUND(diff_days / 365.0, 2) AS y,
    ROUND(MOD(CAST(diff_days AS INTEGER), 365) / 30.0, 2) AS m,
    ROUND(MOD(CAST(diff_days AS INTEGER), 30) / 365.0, 2) AS d
  FROM base
),
spans AS (
  SELECT y + m + d AS span
  FROM parts
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(span), 2) AS avg_career_span
FROM spans

persistent_recovery_advisory_draft.base_sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    (CAST(strftime('%Y', final_game) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', debut) AS INTEGER))
      + (CAST(strftime('%m', final_game) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%m', debut) AS INTEGER))
      + (CAST(strftime('%d', final_game) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%d', debut) AS INTEGER)) AS total_days
  FROM player
  WHERE debut IS NOT NULL AND final_game IS NOT NULL
    AND debut != '' AND final_game != ''
),
parts AS (
  SELECT
    ROUND(ABS(total_days) / 365.0, 2) AS y,
    ROUND(ABS(total_days) % 365 / 30.0, 2) AS m,
    ROUND(ABS(total_days) % 30 / 1.0, 2) AS d
  FROM base
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(y + m/12.0 + d/365.0), 2) AS avg_span
FROM parts;
